rationale: The plan selects limma-voom with TMM and ~condition (control as reference) for the 60 vs 60 unpaired cohort, with filterByExpr, BH at 0.05, and a TREAT test at |log2FC|>=0.5, matching the reference; the Wilcoxon cross-check is reasonable even if the dismissal of NB models is overstated. Enrichment is exemplary: moderated-t ranking, camera plus fgsea, named Hallmark version and Reactome, 15-500 size window, tested-gene universe. QC lacks the sex check against XIST/Y-linked genes and an explicit search for hidden structure with candidate factors, and the outlier policy names but does not decide. Borrowing apeglm shrinkage from a separate DESeq2 fit and then classifying by a post-hoc cutoff on the shrunken estimate is somewhat awkward alongside TREAT, and no confidence interval per log2FC is promised, though the effect-size-beside-p-value requirement and reporting details are otherwise well covered.
